historySource.indexText: Proclaimed Gran Quivira National Monument Nov. 1, 1909. On Dec. 19, 1980, two state monuments, Quarai and Abo were donated to the National Park Service and joined Gran Quivira in forming Salinas National Monument. Renamed Salinas Pueblo Missions National Monument Oct. 28, 1988. Boundary changes: Nov. 25, 1919; Dec. 19, 1980.
